- "I implemented the change myself, and Claude wrote the tests."
- "I prompted an assistant for a first draft, then reworked it until I was
  satisfied with every line."
- "I wrote the code and asked an assistant for the docstrings."

We are a small team, so reviews can take a while; thank you for your patience.
Help with other issues is always welcome, and we value every contribution, no
matter how small.
